name: Puppy Growth Predictor
description: Estimate an adult dog weight range from a puppy's current age, weight and expected breed-size category.
search_intent: Estimate how large a puppy may grow based on its current age, weight and breed-size category.
keywords: how big will my puppy get calculator
calculation: Use breed-size-specific age-to-growth-completion percentages. Estimated adult weight = current weight ÷ estimated fraction of adult weight reached at the entered age. Provide a reasonable uncertainty range around the estimate and expose the growth-progress percentage used. Avoid unrealistic extrapolation for very young puppies and clearly label the result as approximate.
limitations: Growth varies considerably by breed, sex, genetics, nutrition and health.
Mixed-breed adult size can be difficult to predict.
This tool provides an approximate growth estimate, not veterinary advice.
